content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD finite-difference derivative library (BSD header L1-44). Ten subroutines, all with the same shape: args (M,N,Ibeg,Iend,Jbeg,Jend,MASK,DX and/or DY,Uin,Uout), USE PARAM, double DO loop over J=Jbeg..Jend, I=Ibeg..Iend, result multiplied by integer MASK(I,J); each has a CARTESIAN preprocessor branch (scalar DX/DY) and a non-CARTESIAN branch (DX/DY as (M,N) arrays evaluated at (I,J)). (1) DERIVATIVE_Y_High (L52-77): higher-order first y-derivative (Uin(I,J+2)+2*Uin(I,J+1)-Uin(I,J-2)-2*Uin(I,J-1))/DY/8 (L68-69 scalar, L71-72 array). (2) DERIVATIVE_X_High (L88-113): x analog (L104-105, L107-108). (3) DERIVATIVE_Y (L123-148): 2nd-order central (Uin(I,J+1)-Uin(I,J-1))/DY/2 (L139-140, L142-143). (4) DERIVATIVE_X (L158-183): x analog (L174-175, L177-178). (5) DERIVATIVE_YY (L192-217): second derivative (Uin(I,J+1)-2*Uin(I,J)+Uin(I,J-1))/DY^2 (L208-209, L211-212). (6) DERIVATIVE_XY (L226-253): cross derivative via tmp1,tmp2 central y-derivatives at I+1 and I-1 then central x difference (L242-244 scalar, L246-248 array). (7) DERIVATIVE_XX (L263-289): (Uin(I+1,J)-2*Uin(I,J)+Uin(I-1,J))/DX^2 (L280-281, L283-284; comment 'I assume no 2nd derivative' L276). (8) DERIVATIVE_XY_HIGH (L299-341): 4th-order cross derivative — 4th-order y-derivatives tmp1..tmp4 at I-2,I-1,I+1,I+2 with (u(j-2)-8u(j-1)+8u(j+1)-u(j+2))/12/DY stencil (L315-322 scalar, L327-334 array with comment 'to assure symmetric, use locally constant dx and dy' L326), combined as MASK/12/DX*(tmp1-8*tmp2+8*tmp3-tmp4) (L323-324, L335-336). (9) DERIVATIVE_XX_HIGH (L351-377): 4th-order second x-derivative MASK/12/DX^2*(-Uin(I-2,J)+16*Uin(I-1,J)-30*Uin(I,J)+16*Uin(I+1,J)-Uin(I+2,J)) (L368-369, L371-372). (10) DERIVATIVE_YY_HIGH (L387-412): y analog (L403-404 scalar; array branch L406-407).

unresolved: Cross-branch inconsistency in DERIVATIVE_YY_HIGH: the non-CARTESIAN branch's last stencil term is Uin(I+2,J+2) (L407) whereas the CARTESIAN branch uses Uin(I,J+2) (L404); the y-direction 5-point stencil should not shift in I, so L407 appears to be a typo/bug affecting non-CARTESIAN (spherical/curvilinear) builds

Loop indices I,J and temporaries tmp1..tmp4 are not declared in any subroutine here — they come from USE PARAM module scope (L53 etc.), so these routines are not thread-safe with respect to module-level tmp variables

MASK multiplies the result after division (e.g. L69), zeroing derivatives at masked cells but still reading Uin at neighbors up to +/-2 cells; ghost-cell validity at Ibeg-2/Jend+2 is assumed from callers

DERIVATIVE_XY_HIGH header comment says '4th-derivative xy' (L293) and DERIVATIVE_XX_HIGH/YY_HIGH say '4th-derivative xx/yy' (L345,L381) while the implementations are 4th-order-accurate first/second/cross derivatives — comment wording vs implemented operator
